acceptance: Delegated confirmation binds the approving person, the executing caller, the source session and the exact request; an agent credential can neither confirm for itself nor replay or widen it.

positive.fixture: a person confirms through the interface for a delegated caller; the confirmation binds person, executor, session and exact request and works once

negative.fixture: agent credentials cannot confirm for themselves or others; no delegation, self-delegation, withdrawn, expired, widened and extended-expiry confirmations fail

security_and_source_permissions: Delegation is one person, one caller, at most 30 days, withdrawable, and does not widen the executor scopes.
known_limitations: Sign-in generation binding was added in VSF-B14-T14
